scope: Bounded local validation runs, separate from learner experiment results.
measurement: Each run used a fresh Jupyter kernel. seconds covers notebook execution after CUDA initialization and includes CPU setup; kernel_wall_seconds also includes kernel startup. Peak allocated/reserved values are PyTorch CUDA allocator peaks across the run. They exclude non-PyTorch allocations and other processes. Models ran sequentially.
results_interpretation: These bounded runs record code execution and resource use; they do not establish policy success or compare policy quality. No final evaluation states were used.

runs.workload: Three prepared policies, one development state, up to 160 controller steps each
Learner ACT loop, execution lengths 1, 5, 10, one development state, up to 100 steps each
ACT, three learning rates, two seeds, 20 updates per trial, batch size 2
Learner observation and action adapters, prepared ACT, one development state, up to 40 controller steps
Learner row, window and training-statistics callbacks; identical fresh ACT weights; two trials of 20 updates with 2 versus 8 training episodes
CVAE action chunks, three settings, 20 updates per setting, batch size 2
Learner full-size ACT with converted reference weights, 10 real-data updates at batch size 4 and held-out validation
Learner diffusion noise-loss callback through the real prepared policy, two updates on real image and action batches

settings.assertion: assert len(history) == 2 and next(policy.parameters()).is_cuda and not torch.equal(before, policy.diffusion.unet.final_conv[1].weight)

settings.assertion: assert len(history) == 2 and changed and next(learner_unet.parameters()).is_cuda

settings.assertion: assert len(ATTEMPTS) == 2 and all(row.get("chunks", 0) > 0 and "error" not in row.get("ended", "") and "close_error" not in row for row in ATTEMPTS)

settings.assertion: assert same and difference < 1e-4 and next(learner.parameters()).is_cuda

settings.assertion: assert ADAPTATION_DEVICE == "cuda" and len(REAL_ADAPTATION_RESULTS) == 2 and all(row["status"] == "trained" and row["expert_changed"] and row["vlm_hash_unchanged"] and row["rollout"]["status"] == "ok" and row["rollout"]["chunks"] > 0 and "close_error" not in row["rollout"] for row in REAL_ADAPTATION_RESULTS), REAL_ADAPTATION_RESULTS
